videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: The team take on a modern day fast Ford to see if a 'quick flip' could make a few quid and revisit a 3 year MG restoration project that's still not finished.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: A 90s Alfa with electrical issues lives up to its stereotype and the team revisit a road roller, four years on. They also tackle a French motoring icon, the Citroen 2CV6 Dolly.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: The Restoring Classics team take Derek's advice when he sniffs out the rarest car they've ever taken on - the last remaining Hillman GT.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: The team lift the shutters on their biggest restoration to date in the shape of a Series 1 Land Rover.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: A sun-bleached red Vauxhall Astra GTE gives the team a headache. They also buy a classic French moped and catch up on the restoration of a barn find Mini Cooper S.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: The team gamble on restoring a Vanden Plas saloon from the 1970s and a child's tricycle from the 1960s. Plus, catch up on the restoration of a rare Sunbeam Lotus.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: The team are on the hunt to restore one of the greatest names in motoring history - the Bugatti. But with a strict budget they settle for a replica.

videos.title: Director's Short Cut
videos.description: Bringing the best in television.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: The team fly the flag for King and country with one of their most luxurious purchases to date - a 1981 Rolls Royce Silver Spirit.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: The team think they can smell profit by choosing one of the simplest cars ever built, the VW Beetle.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: Bangers & Cash spin-off series that follows the journey of a vehicle purchased at a Mathewsons classic car auction, before being repaired, restored and re-auctioned.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: The team pay over the odds for a VW Campervan, but can they hope to break even when they turn out a lovely bus for auction.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: A 1969 Morris Mini Cooper MkII is totally restored by specialists. They give it the full works, which means only one thing... any chance of profit heads towards an open window.

videos.title: Bangers & Cash: Restoring Classics
videos.description: The Restoring Classics team set out on a Pre-War challenge with a 1939 three wheeled Morgan F4 - and aptly named Russ Storer from MG Mecca is still keen to take it on.

videos.title: Bangers and Cash
videos.description: Dave's son Jack is heading out to Cheshire to collect two cars with a 35-year age difference. And luckily for Mathewsons, Lucy knows exactly what has been brought in for auction.

videos.title: Bangers and Cash
videos.description: A 1970 Excalibur Roadstar, once owned by Roy Orbison, arrives at Thornton le Dale and Derek heads to County Durham to collect a 1935 Austin 7 Ulster that's been completely rebuilt.

videos.title: Bangers and Cash
videos.description: Two iconic British classics find their way to the Mathewsons' auction room; Dave heads to North Manchester to pick up an Austin A30 and a Morris 8 E that's had an alternative paint job.

videos.title: Bangers and Cash
videos.description: New. An impressive collection of five iconic cars arrives at Thornton le Dale, including a 1967 Crayford Corsair and a 1966 Ford Zodiac which emerge from a garage in Selby.

videos.title: Bangers and Cash
videos.description: Nothing screams 1970s more than a Mk3 Ford Cortina 2000E. Derek Mathewson heads to Brigg to value a 1974 example with classic Coke bottle styling and a sweet Pinto engine.

videos.title: Bangers and Cash
videos.description: Dave goes to Wales in order to purchase a Sierra Cosworth, a sought-after car in the bidding market. Dad Derek gets his hands on a more sedate 1926 Standard Tourer - a quirky little motor.

videos.title: Bangers and Cash
videos.description: Derek heads to Suffolk to collect two Bentleys with a majestic pedigree, with their own names: Cynthia a stunning 1963 S3 and Harry, a 1965 Continental.
